_comment: Ground-truth case used by the demo. Produced by the agent pipeline in ../agents, then frozen so the stage demo never depends on network or model latency.

taxpayer.name: Lena Brandt
taxpayer.marginal_rate_note: Marginal income-tax rate at this income in Steuerklasse I. No Soli is levied at this level (Freigrenze not reached). Deliberately conservative — the § 32a tariff gives roughly 36-38% here, so this understates the benefit. Recompute per user in production.

expiring.rule: Antragsveranlagung: four-year assessment window. The 2022 return must be filed by 31 Dec 2026 or the refund lapses permanently.

expenses.label: Arbeitsmittel
expenses.math: GWG, each below the €800 immediate-write-off threshold

calculation.pauschbetrag_statute: § 9a Satz 1 Nr. 1a EStG — Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag, granted automatically
calculation.antragsgrenze_statute: § 39a Abs. 2 Satz 4 EStG — amounts above the Pauschbetrag must exceed €600 to be registrable
calculation.counterfactual: Without registration this €2,196 arrives as a refund in July 2027 — a 14-month interest-free loan to the state.

filing.validity: Valid for two calendar years; re-confirm when income or commute changes.
